description: Audio converter. Convert audio between MP3, AAC, OPUS, FLAC, WAV and OGG. Pick a bitrate, drop it to mono, change the sample rate. Accepts audio/*, .m4a, .opus, .aac, .wma; up to 200 MB per file.

bitrateKbps.description: Bitrate in kbps. Ignored for FLAC and WAV — they are lossless

mono.description: Mix down to one channel. Halves the size of speech recordings

outputDir.description: Where to put the results. Defaults to the folder each source file came from. Existing files are never overwritten.

paths.description: Paths to the files to process, absolute or relative to the working directory.

sampleRate.description: Sample rate. «As is» keeps the original

name: audio_convert
